title: Spectral Regularization Beyond Ridge Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.30440v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study Inclusive Ridge (IR), a two-parameter spectral regularization family that contains ridge regression as well as iterated Tikhonov regularization. We derive its exact finite-sample coefficient risk and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for increasing or decreasing the additional filter-shape parameter around the ridge baseline to locally lower risk. We show that oracle-tuned ridge is generically suboptimal within the IR family. Under joint divergence of the penalty and filter order, we show that a nondegenerate spectral limit exists precisely when their ratio converges to a positive finite constant, yielding a continuous exponential filter. Along the fixed effective-scale path, we also obtain an exact risk-difference comparison and explicit sufficient conditions under which both higher-order estimators and the exponential limiting filter strictly outperform oracle-tuned ridge. translated_title: 超越岭回归的谱正则化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了包容岭回归，这是一个双参数谱正则化族，其中同时包含岭回归和迭代Tikhonov正则化。我们推导了其精确的有限样本系数风险，并建立了在岭回归基线附近增大或减小额外滤波器形状参数以局部降低风险的充分必要条件。我们证明，经神谕调优的岭回归在IR族中通常是次优的。在惩罚强度与滤波器阶数同时发散的情形下，我们证明当二者的比值收敛于一个正的有限常数时，恰好存在非退化的谱极限，从而得到连续的指数滤波器。沿着固定有效尺度的路径，我们还得到了精确的风险差异比较，并给出了明确的充分条件，使得高阶估计量与指数极限滤波器均严格优于经神谕调优的岭回归。在此区域内，IR逐渐变得……
tldr: 本文提出包含岭回归与迭代Tikhonov正则化的双参数谱正则化族“包容岭回归”，精确刻画其有限样本风险，证明神谕调优的岭回归在该族中通常次优，并给出高阶估计量与指数极限滤波器严格优于岭回归的明确条件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the two-parameter Inclusive Ridge spectral regularization family, derives its exact finite-sample coefficient risk, shows that oracle-tuned ridge is generally suboptimal within the family, and establishes explicit conditions under which higher-order estimators and the exponential limiting filter strictly outperform ridge regression.
